paper.title: Finite-Time Analysis of Kernelised Contextual Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Kernelised (RKHS) contextual bandit with N actions and changing contexts
unmapped: Expected reward is linear in the RKHS feature map: E(r_{a,t}|x_{a,t}) = phi(x_{a,t})^T theta*, theta* in H with arbitrary (unknown) RKHS norm
Learner accesses contexts only through the kernel function
Regret measured against the per-round best action a*_t for the current contexts; regret defined via realised rewards
settings.definition_quote: For our non-linear contextual bandit model we assume the existence of a φ for which there exists a θ∗ ∈ H such that: E(ra,t | xa,t) = φ(xa,t)^T θ∗. Taking a∗t := arg max_{a∈A} {φ(xa,t)^T θ∗} we can define the regret as before in (1).

bound.expression_latex: R(T) \le \Big[2 + 2\Big(1+\sqrt{\frac{\gamma}{2\ln(2TN(1+\ln T)/\delta)}}\Big)\|\theta^*\| + 8\sqrt{\Big(12+\frac{15}{\gamma}\Big)\max\Big(\ln\big(\frac{T}{\tilde d\gamma}+1\big),\ln T\Big)^3}\sqrt{2\ln\frac{2TN(1+\ln T)}{\delta}}\Big]\sqrt{\tilde d T}

symbols.d_eff: effective dimension d~ = min{j : j*gamma*ln T >= sum_{i>j} (lambda_{i,T} - gamma)}, data-dependent
symbols.theta_norm: RKHS norm ||theta*|| of the reward parameter
symbols.lam: regularisation parameter gamma of kernel ridge regression

source.quote: Assume that ‖φ(xa,t)‖ ≤ 1 and |ra,t| ∈ [0, 1] for all a ∈ A and t ≥ 1, and set η = sqrt(2 ln 2TN/δ). Then with probability 1 − δ, SupKernelUCB satisfies: R(T) ≤ [2 + 2(1 + sqrt(γ/(2 ln(2TN(1+ln T)/δ))))‖θ∗‖ + 8 sqrt((12 + 15/γ) max(ln(T/(d̃γ)+1), ln T)^3) × sqrt(2 ln(2TN(1+ln T)/δ))] sqrt(d̃T)

results.notes: Text extracted from PDF; bracket placement and exponent 3 on the max term reconstructed from garbled pdftotext and the proof (S = ln T, l_T^{3/2}). N actions mapped to K. Remark 3 states informally Õ(sqrt(L d̃ T)) with gamma ~ 1/L when ||theta*|| <= L, and Õ(||theta*|| sqrt(d̃T)) with constant gamma; with linear kernel d̃ <= d recovering Chu et al. (2011). Regret is defined on realised rewards against per-round best action.
